simple.meaning: אִי (ʼîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “alas!.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אִי (H337) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ecclesiastes 4:10, with occurrences in Ecclesiastes.

simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אִי (H337) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אִי (ʼîy) / H337 is traced through Ecclesiastes 4:10, Ecclesiastes 10:16 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H337. i III. אִי interjection (so in Rabb, see De Koh 197 Wr Eccl 490 ) alas! (late) Eccl 4:10 לוֺ אִי (written in ᵑ0 as one word) alas for him (Ew § 309 c ), the one, who falleth, etc. (i.e. who falleth alone) 10:16 .
